address_spaces.name: I/O
address_spaces.notes: Sixteen small windows of 16 MB fill offsets 0x0000_0000 to 0x0fff_ffff, widget N at N times 16 MB. Seven big windows of 512 MB start at 0x2000_0000. Small window 0 and big window 6 are two views of the same widget, and both decode: Linux reads widget 0's identification register through the small window by its raw address, OpenBSD reaches the same device through the big window, so both paths have to work. See docs/datasheets/address-map.md for the small-window-0 reversal history.

machine.name: Onyx2 rack with one InfiniteReality pipe
machine.notes: Selected installation with two processors and one 64 MiB bank per node. IO1 holds a BaseIO-G with its MediaIO daughtercard, and IO3 holds the Xtown that cables to one pipe in the graphics module: a geometry board, one raster manager with texture memory and a display generator, reached through the graphics module's Ktown. The pipe's one-wire chain answers the geometry record, then the Ktown's. The other optional I/O slots and external CrayLink connectors are empty. This is a selected population, not a captured machine inventory. The full processor mode word is not the full CP0 Config register; only the reviewed low 25 bits transfer. Stock image configuration must agree and is never rewritten by descriptor generation.
